title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Rider: Arrears Recovery Rates and Payoff Tiers
content:
While an enrollment carries an arrears balance, PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) recovers it from payments at the recovery percentage of the tier, subject to the tier's smallest recovery portion per payment. When the arrears balance of a recovery tier is fully recovered, the account moves to the tier named as its payoff tier.

| Tier | Recovery percentage of each gross payment | Smallest recovery portion per payment (USD) | Tier on arrears payoff |
|---|---|---|---|
| PrePay Power Residential | 0 | 0.00 | PrePay Power Residential |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 | 25 | 5.00 | PrePay Power Residential |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 | 40 | 10.00 | PrePay Power Residential |
| PrePay Power Seasonal | 25 | 5.00 | PrePay Power Seasonal |
| PrePay Power Outbuilding | 25 | 5.00 | PrePay Power Outbuilding |
| PrePay Power Small Commercial | 0 | 0.00 | PrePay Power Small Commercial |

## Notes

- A tier whose payoff tier is its own name makes no move at payoff: PrePay Power Residential, PrePay Power Seasonal, PrePay Power Outbuilding and PrePay Power Small Commercial each name themselves.
- PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 and PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 both name PrePay Power Residential as the payoff tier.
- PrePay Power Residential and PrePay Power Small Commercial admit no transferred arrears, so their recovery percentage and smallest portion stand at 0 and 0.00.
